title: Backend Engineer roadmap
summary: A step-by-step guide to deepen your backend expertise, build professional-grade projects, and prepare for senior roles. Focuses on best practices, scalability, and job-ready habits.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish core language and database fundamentals.

milestones.title: Python or Go core
milestones.outcome: Write clean, idiomatic Python or Go code for backend services.

tasks.title: Read language syntax overview
tasks.description: Study the official Python or Go language reference to refresh syntax and core concepts.

tasks.title: Complete basic exercises
tasks.description: Solve 5 coding challenges on freeCodeCamp's Python or Go sections to solidify basics.

tasks.title: Set up development environment
tasks.description: Install VS Code, configure linters (flake8 or golint) and a debugger for the chosen language.

tasks.title: Write a simple CLI tool
tasks.description: Create a command-line program that reads input and prints formatted output, committing to Git.

milestones.title: SQL and data modelling
milestones.outcome: Design relational schemas and write efficient queries.

tasks.title: Read relational theory chapter
tasks.description: Review the normalization chapter on Khan Academy to understand 1NF-3NF.

tasks.title: Practice SELECT queries
tasks.description: Use the public PostgreSQL sample database on db-fiddle.com to write 10 varied SELECT statements.

tasks.title: Model a simple e-commerce schema
tasks.description: Draw an ER diagram for products, orders, and users, then create the tables in a local PostgreSQL instance.

tasks.title: Benchmark query performance
tasks.description: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on two queries and note index usage.

tasks.title: Reflect on schema choices
tasks.description: Write a short note on why you chose primary keys and relationships.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Apply best-practice patterns for APIs, security, and scalability.

tasks.title: Read REST design guide
tasks.description: Study the RESTful API Design guide on MDN for conventions and status codes.

tasks.title: Sketch endpoint map
tasks.description: Create a diagram of resources, verbs, and URL structures for a blog service.

tasks.title: Write OpenAPI spec
tasks.description: Use Swagger Editor to draft a YAML spec for the blog API.

tasks.title: Implement a GET endpoint
tasks.description: Code a Flask (or Gin) route that returns JSON for a single blog post.

tasks.title: Peer-review spec
tasks.description: Share the OpenAPI file with a colleague and incorporate feedback.

tasks.title: Read JWT basics
tasks.description: Read the JSON Web Token introduction on jwt.io to understand token flow.

tasks.title: Generate a JWT in code
tasks.description: Write a small script that creates and verifies a JWT using a secret key.

tasks.title: Add auth middleware
tasks.description: Integrate JWT verification middleware into the blog API routes.

tasks.title: Write auth unit tests
tasks.description: Create tests that ensure protected endpoints reject invalid tokens.

tasks.title: Discuss auth trade-offs
tasks.description: Join an online forum thread about session vs token auth and summarize key points.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Build portfolio projects that showcase end-to-end backend capabilities.

milestones.title: REST API with auth and tests
milestones.outcome: Deliver a production-ready API featuring authentication and full test coverage.

tasks.title: Plan project scope
tasks.description: Define resources, endpoints, and data models for a task-management API.

tasks.title: Set up repo and CI
tasks.description: Create a GitHub repo, add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs lint and tests on push.

tasks.title: Implement CRUD endpoints
tasks.description: Code create, read, update, delete routes with proper validation.

tasks.title: Add JWT auth
tasks.description: Secure the endpoints with token middleware and role checks.

tasks.title: Write integration tests
tasks.description: Use pytest (or Go’s testing package) to test full request-response cycles.

tasks.title: Document API with Swagger
tasks.description: Generate OpenAPI docs and host them via Swagger UI.

milestones.title: URL shortener with analytics
milestones.outcome: Create a service that shortens URLs and tracks click metrics.

tasks.title: Design data model
tasks.description: Model tables for URLs, short codes, and click logs in PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Implement shortening endpoint
tasks.description: Write an API that generates a unique short code and stores the mapping.

tasks.title: Add redirect worker
tasks.description: Build a background handler that logs clicks and redirects to the original URL.

tasks.title: Introduce caching layer
tasks.description: Cache recent short-code lookups using Redis to reduce DB hits.

tasks.title: Create analytics endpoint
tasks.description: Expose an API that returns click counts per short code.

tasks.title: Write end-to-end tests
tasks.description: Automate tests that create a short URL, simulate clicks, and verify analytics.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Advance with performance patterns and prepare for job or client interviews.

milestones.title: Caching and queues
milestones.outcome: Integrate Redis caching and a message queue for asynchronous processing.

tasks.title: Read Redis intro
tasks.description: Review the Redis Quick Start guide on redis.io for basic commands.

tasks.title: Cache API responses
tasks.description: Add Redis caching to the URL shortener’s redirect endpoint with TTL.

tasks.title: Set up RabbitMQ locally
tasks.description: Install RabbitMQ via Docker and explore the management UI.

tasks.title: Create a job worker
tasks.description: Write a worker that consumes messages to send email notifications.

tasks.title: Benchmark cache impact
tasks.description: Measure response times with and without Redis cache and note improvements.

tasks.title: Reflect on async design
tasks.description: Write a brief note on when to use queues versus direct processing.

milestones.title: Testing
milestones.outcome: Apply testing strategies across unit, integration, and load tests.

tasks.title: Read testing pyramid article
tasks.description: Study the testing pyramid on Martin Fowler’s website to understand test layers.

tasks.title: Add property-based tests
tasks.description: Use hypothesis (Python) or gopter (Go) to generate random inputs for a core function.

tasks.title: Implement load testing script
tasks.description: Create a Locust (or k6) script that simulates 100 concurrent users on the API.

tasks.title: Integrate coverage reporting
tasks.description: Configure CI to upload coverage reports to Codecov.

tasks.title: Conduct a test review session
tasks.description: Pair with a peer to review failing tests and improve assertions.

tasks.title: Document testing strategy
tasks.description: Write a one-page guide summarizing your testing approach for future projects.

milestones.title: Job/client readiness
milestones.outcome: Present your work confidently and navigate technical interviews.

tasks.title: Update portfolio site
tasks.description: Add project descriptions, tech stack, and links to live demos on your personal website.

tasks.title: Craft STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) narratives for each milestone achievement.

tasks.title: Mock system design interview
tasks.description: Participate in a 45-minute mock design interview with a colleague using a whiteboard tool.

tasks.title: Review common backend questions
tasks.description: Study top backend interview questions on LeetCode Discuss and note key concepts.

tasks.title: Network with peers
tasks.description: Join a backend engineering Slack community and share a recent project for feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on growth gaps
tasks.description: Write a short reflection on areas needing improvement before applying for senior roles.
